title.narrative: Reinforcing EU Dimension of UA Civil Service in Law-Making, Judiciary, Finances
Stärka EU-dimensionen i förvaltningen: lagstiftningen, rättsväsendet, finanserna

description.narrative:
The intervention's goal is to strengthen the capacity of target institutions in the areas of Law-Making, Judiciary, and Public Finances by improving the internal (knowledge, skills, procedures) and external (digital tools, information sources, formats for interacting with stakeholders) components of civil servants' work towards EU standards.
Specific Objectives. 1.To strengthen the capacity of civil servants in Secretariats of the Parliament and the Cabinet of Ministers, and key central executive bodies to develop and implement policies in the process of European integration.
2.To enhance the capacity of supervisory bodies to execute their functions and civic oversight over public spending.
3.To enhance the efficiency, transparency, and institutional resilience of the Constitutional Court of Ukraine, the Supreme Court, High Specialised Courts, and the High Qualification Commission of Judges of Ukraine through digital modernisation, procedural reform, and strengthened capacity of their Secretariats.

Insatsernas mål är att stärka målinstitutionernas kapacitet på områdena lagstiftning, rättsväsende och offentliga finanser genom att förbättra de interna (kunskaper, färdigheter, förfaranden) och externa (digitala verktyg, informationskällor, format för interaktion med berörda parter) delarna av tjänstemännens arbete mot EU-standarder.
